Compute Screener

Free API and CSV

Every price on Compute Screener is free to use: JSON files you can call like an API, and daily CSV files. No key and no sign-up. The data is CC BY 4.0: use it, including commercially, with credit to "Compute Screener (computescreener.com)".

JSON API

Plain GET requests to the files the website itself reads. They can be fetched from a browser on any site. GPU files are updated every 2 to 3 hours, token files once a day.

https://computescreener.com/data/
FileWhat it returns
index.jsonLatest GPU rental prices in USD per GPU-hour. Per GPU: value, date, chg_1d, chg_7d, chg_30d (fractions: 0.012 is +1.2%), its benchmark contract, and each provider's average in providers (name, avg standardized, posted, read, src). A GPU not yet published has value null.
series.jsonEach GPU's daily history: d (US Central day), v (value), final (false for today's provisional value), p (providers), w (weekly history, before 23 October 2026).
providers.jsonEach provider's offers for each GPU: the lowest and highest posted price per GPU-hour and the cheapest configuration.
tokens.jsonLatest AI token prices in USD per 1M tokens (3 input : 1 output) for each company, with each model's input, output, blended price and share of the company's tokens.
token_series.jsonEach company's daily token index: d (UTC day), v, final, h (history rebuilt from earlier posted prices).
models.jsonEach model in the token index: its daily input and output prices and share of its company's tokens.

Examples

The H100 price, from a terminal:

curl -s https://computescreener.com/data/index.json | jq '.gpus.H100.value'

Python, every GPU with its 1-day change:

import requests

idx = requests.get("https://computescreener.com/data/index.json").json()
for gpu, e in idx["gpus"].items():
    if e["value"] is not None:
        print(gpu, e["value"], f"{e['chg_1d']:+.1%}")

JavaScript:

const idx = await (await fetch("https://computescreener.com/data/index.json")).json();
console.log(idx.gpus.B200.value);

CSV

Daily CSV copies of the same data, refreshed every day on GitHub at renshuBTC/compute-screener. Each link below is the file itself:

FileOne row per
gpu_index_daily.csvGPU and day: the index in USD per GPU-hour
gpu_providers_latest.csvGPU and provider: the provider's latest average
token_index_daily.csvAI company and day: the token index in USD per 1M tokens
token_models_latest.csvModel: its latest input, output and blended price
token_models_daily.csvModel and day: its input and output prices

In pandas:

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/renshuBTC/compute-screener/main/data/gpu_index_daily.csv")

Good to know

  • How every value is calculated: Methodology. Prices change every 2 to 3 hours, so polling more often adds nothing.
  • In Claude, ChatGPT and other AI apps, the MCP connector answers with the same figures.
  • Prices are information, not investment advice. Questions: Support.
